faqs.question: What do I receive upon purchasing a website?
faqs.answer: You receive a complete, unminified digital deliverable archive including full React and TypeScript source files, CSS stylesheets, asset folders, configuration files, and a step-by-step PDF Deployment Guide tailored for Vercel, Netlify, or self-hosted servers.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you support in Pakistan and internationally?
faqs.answer: For clients in Pakistan, we accept JazzCash, Easypaisa, and direct Bank Transfer (Meezan Bank). For international buyers, wire transfer and international card payments are supported in USD.

faqs.question: How long does payment verification take?
faqs.answer: When you submit your JazzCash/Easypaisa TID or bank payment reference, our verification desk validates the transaction within 30 to 90 minutes during active operating hours. Once approved, files become downloadable in your Customer Dashboard immediately.

faqs.question: Can I request custom modifications for my business?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can choose the Professional package or request a Custom Website Project quote. Our senior engineering team can integrate custom databases, modify branding, wire custom payment gateways, and configure custom domain DNS.

faqs.question: Do you charge any recurring monthly license fees?
faqs.answer: No. All ready-made websites on Markety Studio are one-time purchases with a commercial license for a single production deployment. You own the code without recurring subscription fees.

policies.title: Commercial Website Licensing Terms
policies.content:
When you purchase any ready-made website or application on Smart Developer, you receive a standard single-end-product commercial license unless an enterprise reselling license is explicitly arranged.

What You Can Do:
• Use the source code for your personal or commercial business website.
• Modify, rebrand, adapt, and expand any part of the source code.
• Deploy to any hosting service (Vercel, Netlify, AWS, VPS, cPanel).
• Integrate your own payment gateways, APIs, databases, and branding assets.

What You Cannot Do:
• Resell or redistribute the raw source code on another template marketplace.
• Claim original authorship of the Smart Developer base architecture without license.

policies.title: Verified Website Delivery Policy
policies.content:
Smart Developer follows a strict payment verification and instant digital deliverable release workflow.

Delivery Workflow:
1. Order Creation: Customer chooses package tier and selects payment method.
2. Payment Submission: Customer sends payment via JazzCash, Easypaisa, or Bank Transfer and enters the TID/Reference in the portal.
3. Verification: Smart Developer administrative verification team validates receipt against bank/merchant logs.
4. File Release: Deliverables (Full Source ZIP, Deployment Guide, Migration Scripts) become immediately downloadable inside your Customer Dashboard.

Average verification turnaround during business hours is 30–90 minutes. You will also receive an email notification when files are unlocked.

policies.title: Refund & Defect Warranty Policy
policies.content:
Because Smart Developer provides full unminified digital source code, purchases are governed by standard software licensing regulations.

Code Quality Guarantee:
Every website listing undergoes multi-device responsiveness testing and TypeScript type check validation. If you find a verified defect or broken component that differs from the live demo, our engineering team will provide code patches free of charge within the 30-day warranty window.

Refund Eligibility:
Refunds can be requested if an order has not yet been verified or if technical delivery fails and our team is unable to rectify the issue within 5 business days. Once source code ZIP files have been downloaded by the customer, refunds cannot be processed due to the irrevocable nature of digital goods.

policies.title: Developer Support Scope & Guidelines
policies.content:
We are committed to helping you launch smoothly and successfully.

Starter Package Support:
Includes comprehensive PDF setup guide, environment variable checklist, and 30 days of email assistance for installation questions.

Professional Package Support:
Includes hands-on remote deployment onto your server/domain, payment gateway configuration assistance, and direct WhatsApp developer priority support for 60 days.

policies.title: Privacy & Data Security Policy
policies.content:
Smart Developer values customer privacy. We collect only necessary contact and billing details to process orders, verify payments, and deliver software files.

We do not sell, rent, or share personal information with third parties. All transactional records and payment receipts are encrypted and stored in secure restricted databases.
